issues: TypeScript error: src/lib/ledgerHelpers.ts does not export a member named 'setLedger' which is imported in many tests (e.g., m7, m8, m11). The file only contains initLedgerIfNeeded and no getLedger/setLedger functions.

TypeScript error: src/lib/ledger.ts does not export the functions 'appendEntryForReceipt' and 'appendEntryForMileage' which are imported throughout the test suite (e.g., m8, m9, m10, m11). Only a placeholder appendLedgerEntry is exported.

src/lib/ledgerHelpers.ts initLedgerIfNeeded is a no‑op placeholder; it never imports existing receipts/mileage entries as "imported" ledger entries on first launch (R11‑R12) and does not store the ledger in the encrypted Store (R13).

Missing implementations for required functions: getLedger, setLedger, appendEntryForReceipt, appendEntryForMileage, import existing records, clear ledger on "Delete all data", etc. Consequently many unit tests (R45‑R53) will fail.

The History screens (src/screens/ReceiptHistoryScreen.tsx, src/screens/MileageHistoryScreen.tsx) are listed as planned but not implemented.
Missing UI components: src/components/ui/HistoryList.tsx and src/components/ui/VerificationStatus.tsx are referenced in the plan but not present, causing UI flow and rendering failures (R21‑R25).
SettingsScreen (src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx) does not import or call verifyLedger, nor does it display the ledger verification status text required by R24‑R25.

Export verification code functionality is absent: src/lib/exportVerification.ts is referenced in tests but does not exist, and generateCsv/exportPdf do not append the required verification line nor create an "export.created" ledger entry (R26‑R28).

Many unit tests that validate hash chaining, canonical JSON, ledger import, verification, export verification, and backup restoration are currently failing or will fail due to the missing implementations (R40‑R53).

feedback: The core ledger functionality, verification logic, UI screens, and related components are not implemented beyond placeholders.
